purpose: Reachability corpus. 154 synthetic but realistic prompts, balanced across complexity, width, duration, dominant capability and risk. This set exists to measure COVERAGE -- which model x effort x mode combinations the rules can actually produce -- and is deliberately separate from evals/routing/evals.json, which measures CORRECTNESS on hand-graded golden answers. A prompt here is not a golden answer; it is a labelled point in the decision space.

labels.cap: dominant capability tag from SKILL.md Step 2
labels.W: width 0-3 (2 = 6-99 files/units, 3 = 100+ or 3+ independent parallelisable angles)
labels.O: orchestration load, low|high -- 3+ DIFFERENT KINDS of step sequenced and re-entered
labels.P: parallelisable strands, low|high -- 3+ strands that proceed unaware of each other
labels.A: autonomy horizon, low|high -- hours of unattended agentic execution, or a stated flagship-tier shortfall
labels.indiv: the difficulty is ONE indivisible novel-design or formal decision (the same test Rule E3 uses)
labels.builds: the task builds / changes / drives the artefact, rather than reading or reviewing it
labels.agentic_write: writing or restructuring code across multiple dependent steps (the Codex +1 notch test)
labels.front_loaded: difficulty concentrates in the plan; execution then repeats a pattern (opusplan condition 2)
labels.structured_design: dominant capability is structured design / architecture (opusplan condition 1)
labels.P_kind: targets|strands|null -- which KIND of parallelism. The rules before this pass counted only targets; strands of work inside one job were invisible to them.
labels.gates: Step 1 hard gates the prompt fires
labels.flags: user-stated facts that change routing: escalation, prior_run_fell_short, daybreak, glasswing
